@Sofia, the two numbers Bettina posted here on 17 Nov 2025 were 12% and then 10%. Her second message says to ignore the 12% and that the correct figure is 10%. She said she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark, so 10% is the figure that stood in the channel.

I can't confirm from here that 10% is the signed term. The channel shows the correction, but not the signed order form or amendment. June Osei-Lark on the deal desk can confirm the final figure against the paperwork before it goes into the renewal brief.
